page.notes: The text ends mid-word: "qua-" is printed at the line end and "rum" alone at the foot of the column. The Arabic marginal notes at the top right are only partly legible (the Arabic line in the middle, "فيه", is uncertain) and have been copied as far as the scan allows. The Arabic inline words "المتكلمون", "طايفة من المتكلمين واهل النظر", "المعتزلة" and "افترقوا عشرين فرقة" are copied from the scan. The italic markings are approximate. The "Digitized by Google" watermark at the bottom right is left out.
